scope.summary: Author the region-pair compensation morphs per Section 13.17 (BK-17.4, TAI-BK-053), closing REQ-006: breast x ribcage seam, glute x thigh crease, and belly x hip overlap compensation authored as gated pair-correctives (kind='compensation' on bodykit_morph_assets) whose mask is the DECLARED UNION of exactly two region masks, activating only when both source channels are non-default, and appearing in the coupling-graph inspector like any link. Full-body compensation morphs are prohibited.
acceptance_criteria: CompensationMorph rows (kind='compensation') declare exactly two source channel keys and a mask that is the union of exactly those two channels' region masks; registration rejects masks exceeding the declared pair union (full-body compensation prohibited, typed error).

Activation gating: the compensation contributes zero deltas when either source channel is at default; contribution ramps with a documented gating function when both are non-default (multiplicative gate test at (0, x), (x, 0), (x, y)).
The three canonical pairs ship: breast_x_ribcage_seam, glute_x_thigh_crease, belly_x_hip_overlap, each with fixture assets and crease-quality assertions at extreme pair values.
Compensations appear in list_links / the coupling-graph inspector output as typed 'compensation' entries with per-entry disable (MT-496 surface parity).
BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID extended: compensation deltas must stay inside the declared pair-union mask; a poisoned fixture outside the union fails.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without gated pair-correctives, extreme adjacent regions (huge breasts against a skinny ribcage) show seam artifacts, and the Daz answer — sprawling hidden full-body MCMs — is exactly the invisible coupling BodyKit prohibits; pair-scoped gating keeps fixes local and inspectable.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
